releaseNotes: OcuPathIF v0.97.1 updates Tissue Select to the CABR-v2 shared-boundary algorithm, adds configurable fragment cleanup in square micrometres and visible processing progress, and fixes Manual Select reclassification/deletion gaps, restored-overlay alignment, and channel Reset value synchronization. Model save/reload, histories, multi-type/multi-tab training, and Batch Tissue Select behavior are preserved.
